function: monster values from CARDROLLS:s {
X: 0
loop C over CARDROLLS {
 if C <= 13 {
  X: X + 1d{85,60,60,60,85,85,85,85,85,100,100,100,100,140,140,140,165,165,190,190}
 } else if C <= 17 {
  X: X + 1d{170,170,170,170,400,400,400,300,300,300,400,400,400,330,330,330,500,500,400,400}
 } else if C <= 19 {
  X: X + 1d{900,900,900,1500,1500,1500,1400,1400,1400,900,900,900,1200,1200,1200,1600,1600,1600,3000,3000}
 } else if X <= 20 {
  X: X+ 1d{1200,1200,1200,1600,1600,1600,5000,5000,5000,2500,2500,2500,8000,8000,8000,11000,11000,8000,8000,15000}
 } else {
   X: X + 999999
 }
}
result: X
}

output [monster values from d20]
